verdict.rationale: Mesh ships its own event-driven automation: agentic workflows auto-escalate high-risk cases and auto-remediate level 1 alerts. Users can configure the risk-score equation and screening configurations, and agent configurations are customizable outside the Starter Plan. However, nothing documents a general user-defined 'when event X, do action Y' rule builder, and the WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks only notify external systems rather than performing actions. Missing for 10: a documented user-authored event→action rule engine, the range of triggerable actions, details of how agent or monitoring rules are customized, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
